title: Newly Renovated Condo by the Lake
description:
Cleanliness is my most important part of this space..... Please read my reviews. 

     Condo only 1 exit away from the airport and 2 miles from Nashville Shores water park. Located less then a mile from interstate 40. 10 minute drive to downtown ($15 Uber Ride) Hiking trails all around. Modern Decor, hardwood floors, private deck with gas grill. Lake access to Percy Priest Lake!

The space
Modern but cozy decor. Super clean! Please let me know if you see anything I can improve on..

Guest access
Guest are welcome to access any area of the house except the attic and bedroom closets.

Other things to note
I have 2 external camera's on each entrance used for safety reasons.
